text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH error rate (5xx) for service=inference-gateway, region=eu-west1. Alert: pd_trigger/5xx_rate > 300/min for 2m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerduty: Incident INC12345 created and assigned to schedule: infra-oncall-eu (sara_oncall). Escalation policy: 10m -> escalate to nate_sre.

sara_oncall: acked. I'm on it, will check routing and canary pools.

nate_sre: on standby. sara, do we have increased backend 502s or proxy timeouts?

sara_oncall: dashboards show spike in 502 and 503 across multiple AZs in eu-west1. RTT also increased. Seems like fanout volume doubled.

maria_prod: customer-impact flagged: several API keys reporting degraded responses. Notifying the top 3 customers now.

alex_platform: snapshot from edge logs (sample):
```
[2026-03-16T22:10:12Z] proxy=ingress-1 svc=inference-gateway status=502 upstream=kv-cache-x error="upstream read timeout"
[2026-03-16T22:10:13Z] proxy=ingress-2 svc=inference-gateway status=502 upstream=worker-y latency=1.2s
```

sara_oncall: initial hypothesis: adaptive routing attempted to fanout to more replicas, causing increased load and throttle on KV cache -> cascade of 5xx. Runbook: https://docs.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx

dana_support: which customers are affected? I'll open support tickets and provide ETA.

nate_sre: checking k8s rollout history, looks like a non-disruptive autoscaler event at 22:08. Scaling policy might've routed traffic to cold nodes. Querying pod logs.

alex_platform: pod list eu-west1 (truncated):
```
inference-0  Running  3/3  Ready   22:05
inference-1  Running  1/3  NotReady 22:09  (OOMKills: 2)
```

sara_oncall: taking action: 1) pin traffic away from eu-west1 to fallback region (us-west2) for high-tier customers, 2) disable adaptive fanout policy for gateway for 15m, 3) warm up kv-cache nodes. Triggering reroute now.

maria_prod: please add note to status page: short blurb about degraded service in eu-west1, we are mitigating. I'll post update in 10m.

pagerduty: INC12345 acknowledged by sara_oncall at 2026-03-16T22:12:01Z. Next escalation at 22:22 if not resolved.

nate_sre: command I ran to test fallback routing: `curl -i -H "Host: api.redwood.ai" https://usw2-gateway.internal/health` -> returned 200. Fallback path healthy.

sara_oncall: reroute applied (route_policy=regional-fallback:eu-west1->us-west2). Observability: 5xx rate in eu-west1 trending down, overall latency for affected API keys dropping.

alex_platform: I disabled adaptive_fanout flag on inference-gateway config and restarted sidecar on two hot pods.

dana_support: opened ticket for customer A (CUST-789), told them we routed traffic and investigating root cause.

maria_prod: status page update posted: "Degraded responses for API customers in eu-west1. Traffic routed to fallback region; engineers investigating."

incident-bot: Note: automatic suppression applied to noisy alerts for same signature for 10m.

sara_oncall: monitoring the metrics. If 5xx < 10/min for 5m, we'll start rolling back routing.

nate_sre: quick log snippet after mitigations:
```
[2026-03-16T22:17:30Z] proxy=ingress-1 svc=inference-gateway status=200 upstream=usw2-worker latency=0.18s
```

sara_oncall: cool down observed. I'll hand off to post-incident triage after stabilizing. Keeping INC12345 open until root cause validated.

dana_support: customers informed, will update after root-cause.

alex_platform: oob note: need to add a safety to avoid simultaneous fanout + cold-scale. Filing follow-up ticket: PLAT-4567.

maria_prod: thx team. Posting retrospective placeholder.

incident-bot: INC12345 status: MONITORING. Last update 2026-03-16T22:24:50Z.

sara_oncall: handing off to nate_sre for postmortem and RCA. Leaving note: check autoscaler cooldown and kv-cache eviction thresholds.

nate_sre: acknowledged handoff. I'll own the RCA and schedule triage. Closing out Slack thread once postmortem is published. :white_check_mark:
